item.title: PHP Techniques for Generating RFC 4122 Compliant UUID v4 Identifiers
item.description:
“PHP Techniques for Generating RFC 4122 Compliant UUID v4 Identifiers”

How can a developer reliably construct a Version 4 Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) in PHP, ensuring strict compliance with RFC 4122, particularly considering variations across different PHP versions and environments?

Generating a UUIDv4 involves producing 128 bits of random data and then strategically setting specific bits within that data structure to signify its version (4) and variant (DCE 1.1). RFC 4122 specifies these alterations occur in the 7th and 9th octets.
